messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: RRO running very slow
parts:
Hi Srinivas,

We might need a little more information to be able to help you. Are your users saying their R scripts run slow in Revolution R Open compared to R from CRAN, or just that they are running slow in general? If the latter, that's not something we can help with here (although you may like to consider a Revolution R Plus technical support subscription: http://www.revolutionanalytics.com/plus ).

If RRO is running slow compared to CRAN R, could you ask one of your users to send an R script that replicates the problem?

Also, I will note you are not using the latest version of Revolution R Open. You can download version 8.0.1 from http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/open/ . However, I would not expect it to make much of a difference regarding performance.

Kind regards,
# David Smith

messages.subject: Re: [RRO] RRO running very slow
parts: Do you know if anyone of your  current 3 users is using a lot of RAM in one of their R sessions? From 1TB of RAM that you have available,  85% is being used...  Someone might be running something in R that is consuming all the memory...
top - 18:14:22 up 27 days, 15:28,  3 users,  load average: 0.77, 0.78, 0.86

It can be someone working with a huge data structure, I have seen this before... 

Guillermo
